name: proto-blocks/cadco-image-carousel
title: Cadco Image Carousel
description: An endlessly repeating diagonal band of photographs that advances as the section passes through the viewport. Images near the centre are sharp and full size; those further out recede, blur and fade.

images.label: Images
images.help: Three or more works best. The band repeats endlessly, so the last image is followed by the first.

travel.label: Images advanced per screen
travel.help: How far the band travels while the section crosses the viewport. Higher moves faster against the page.

tilt.label: Perspective tilt (degrees)
tilt.help: How far images turn away as they leave the centre. 0 keeps the band flat.

bandHeight.label: Band height (px)
bandHeight.help: The band needs room for the diagonal, not just for one image: outer images sit ~225px off centre AND are enlarged by the perspective projection, so measured clearance at full size is ~820px. Below that the tops and bottoms clip.

zIndex.label: Stacking order
zIndex.help: Negative sends the band behind neighbouring sections, which is what you want when a negative margin pulls it up under the one above.

smoothing.label: Catch-up (tenths of a second)
smoothing.help: How long the band takes to settle after the page stops moving. 0 pins it rigidly to the scrollbar; higher glides.

paddingTop.label: Padding top (px)
paddingTop.help: Space inside the section, above the band.

paddingBottom.label: Padding bottom (px)
paddingBottom.help: Space inside the section, below the band.

marginTop.label: Margin top (px)
marginTop.help: Space outside the section. Negative pulls it up over whatever sits above, which is how sections overlap.

marginBottom.label: Margin bottom (px)
marginBottom.help: Space outside the section. Negative pulls the next section up over this one.
